title: Malicious code in @theholocron/holocron-plugin-discord (npm)
description: The npm package @theholocron/holocron-plugin-discord version 5.0.0-alpha.436 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it, and immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised computer is strongly advised.
